findings.comment: While `_redisImageName` is now used to start the Redis server container, the monitor container launched in `Start()` (line 138) still runs `redis` directly: `run -i --name {_dockerMonitorContainerName} --link {_dockerContainerName}:redis --rm redis redis-cli -h redis -p 6379`. Previously, line 116 pre-pulled `redis:latest`, so line 138 reused the local image. Now line 138 will trigger an un-mirrored pull of `redis:latest` from Docker Hub, re-introducing the rate limiting this PR aims to prevent.
